sourceFile: 1. BRS-161014  Report test new design of LAI machine- 2024.10.19_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the report topic but misgroups dates as the changed condition instead of the new LAI machine design validation.
issues: Changed factor should be new LAI machine design, not daily dates.
No explicit normal/baseline comparator is cited.
Dates are time subgroups, with line E2-3B as subgroup context.
Result header rows are needed to support metric meanings.
Outcome should include daily NG counts/rates under one validation context.
correctionPlan: Set changedCondition to new LAI machine design/test design.
Set baselineCondition to not explicit or none cited.
Move dates and E2-3B into subgroup keys/subresults.
Add result header evidence rows NG rate!16-18.
Keep one process-defect outcome with daily input, OK, NG, and NG rate.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are partly sufficient, but headers and title/purpose rows must support the corrected grouping.
